_provenance.notes: Root / is a 4s video splash that JS-redirects to /home. Site is Bootstrap 5.3.3 + jQuery + FontAwesome. Palette/type aggregated from /css/style.css and captured pages; the lean crawl.mjs does not emit per-section computed styles, so visual tokens sourced from the live stylesheet.

logo.description: Green sycamore tree mark left of a black serif 'SYCAMORE PARTNERS' wordmark, divided by a thin green rule.

type.note: style.css declares the families with swapped generic fallbacks; intent is Merriweather=serif display, Work Sans=sans body. Wordmark uses a Trajan-like serif (in logo image).

heroMedium.location: site entry splash (/) — autoplay loop muted, then redirects to /home after 4s
heroMedium.note: This animated tree/brand reveal is the site's signature motion and MUST be reproduced, not flattened.

voice.firstParagraph: Sycamore Partners is a private equity firm based in New York specializing in consumer, distribution and retail-related investments. The firm has approximately $11 billion in aggregate committed capital.
